injuries.detail: Lawal is out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors due to tightness in his right groin.
De Larrea (knee) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.
Lively (foot) is out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.
Biberovic (heel) is out for Wednesday's game against the Warriors.
Horford (back) is out for Wednesday's game against the Mavericks, but will play Thursday against the Grizzlies, Nick Friedell of The Athletic reports.
Williams (hamstring) has progressed to on-court activities and will be re-evaluated Saturday.
Curry has been diagnosed with an oblique abdominal tear and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.
Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.
Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN rep
Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.
